theme: ICP against InvariantCausalPrediction, in and out of the claim

regimes.icp_appendix_g: linear Gaussian SEMs drawn as in Peters, Buhlmann and Meinshausen (2016, Appendix G): 5 to 12 nodes, two environments of 100 to 500 rows, noise interventions per row on one or more variables but the target, new weights a third of the time; one SEM per scenario
regimes.icp_appendix_g_target: the icp_appendix_g scenarios with Appendix G's intervened set, which can hold the target (out of the claim)
regimes.icp_do: observation and 2 or 3 single-variable do-interventions N(2, 0.2^2) on other variables than the target, 6 or 10 nodes, 200 rows per environment, drawn by andrey.data
regimes.icp_appendix_g_capped: icp_appendix_g at 16, 21, or 40 nodes, targets with at most 3 parents, max_parents=3
regimes.icp_hidden: icp_appendix_g with a hidden parent of the target and of one other variable (out of the claim)
regimes.icp_nonlinear: icp_appendix_g with tanh of one parent in the target's equation (out of the claim)
regimes.icp_speed: icp_appendix_g weights at 9, 12, and 15 nodes with 500 + 500 rows, and 12 nodes with 5000 + 5000 rows

verdict_rule: D = error(Andrey) - error(InvariantCausalPrediction) per paired fit; worse when the paired 95% percentile-bootstrap interval of the mean D lies entirely above 0, better when entirely below, a tie otherwise
fit_protocol: every fit on 1 core, 4 at a time, no wall cap; Andrey's speed rows are the median of 3 timed fits after one untimed one, the others one fit; R's time covers its ICP() call alone
error_metric: each entry's own, in its error_metric
complete_definition: true when every planned fit finished; no fit timed out
seeds_note: scenario seeds [658, cell, scenario] and dataset seeds [658, cell, scenario, dataset], as benchmarks/icp_cpu.py draws them; a row's seeds counts its paired datasets, the datasets of its scenarios that both packages fit, and the cell B rows hold the first 20 datasets of each scenario whose intervened set holds the target

methods.comparator_setting: ICP(selection='all', or 'lasso' with every variable kept and maxNoVariablesSimult=3 under max_parents=3; maxNoObs above every environment's rows; stopIfEmpty=FALSE; alpha=0.05)
methods.error_metric: the parents' symmetric difference with the true parents (the SHD of the target's parent edges), medians over the paired fits, means in the _mean fields; andrey_fwer and comparator_fwer are the shares of fits whose estimate is not a subset of the true parents
methods.hardware: Intel Core i7-7820X, 1 core per fit, 4 fits at a time; Andrey and R fit the same datasets in the same worker
methods.same_graph_test: equal estimated parent sets; same_accepted_sets counts equal accepted sets
